comment: The DSP is Émilie Gillet's Clouds, vendored unchanged at eurorack/clouds, in the Monsoon layout with the standard firmware; src/nebulae.cpp is the Rack wrapper, resampling to the hardware's 32kHz. Every jack is read with getVoltage() or getVoltageSum(), so nothing here is polyphonic. The right audio input is normalled to the left at nebulae.cpp:205. Both the freeze gate at nebulae.cpp:292 and the trigger at nebulae.cpp:211 read high at 1V, which the manual does not give. The freeze gate is OR-ed with the button, so either one freezes the buffer. The hardware's ability to save and load the audio buffer is not implemented, and the maker says so in a footnote.
